claim_basis: Parent review identified that the pre-fix portable blitter wrote the selector byte directly as a framebuffer palette index. The workspace no longer contains that pre-fix source snapshot; this record preserves the observed counterexample without claiming a new replay against the absent code.

counterexample.prior_portable_behavior: Write palette index 16 directly; HostPresent accepts only indices 0..15, so the renderer rejects the pixel.
counterexample.original_dos_behavior: S00 o00_3126_0000 expands selector 16 to a 4x4 pattern whose indexed colors are all in 0..15.
counterexample.retest: The new differential compares all selectors 0..23 against original DOS raster output and passes for both converter entries and profiles 0/8.

overview_c.provenance: Hash copied from the preserved invalid oracle-setup report; that report does not establish that this exact file revision contains the reviewed direct-index path.

limitations: The pre-fix overview source bytes were not archived, so the reported old path cannot be source-hash-bound more strongly than the provenance above.
The new comparison normalizes the original DOS planar output to 4-bit indexed pixels; it makes no physical VGA or RGB claim.
